info.title: Welfare Policy Search API
info.description: Search Korean central, local, and connected youth-policy services using age, gender, residence, employment, household and child information.

post.summary: Search personalized welfare and youth policies
post.description: Search and rank central welfare, local welfare, and Ontong Youth policy candidates. Ranking can use age, gender, residence, employment, marital/household status, child presence and child ages. Mental-health interest may include psychological counseling, mental health, emotional support, depression/anxiety/stress and related local services. Results never guarantee eligibility; official requirements and current application dates must be verified.

age.description: User age in full years. Example: 29

gender.description: Optional gender used only when a policy explicitly has gender-related targeting.

sido.description: Province or metropolitan city. Example: 울산광역시

sigungu.description: City, county, or district. Example: 북구. When provided, prioritize this locality and avoid other locality-only programs.

employmentStatus.description: Employment status such as 미취업, 재직중, 단시간근로, 프리랜서, 일용근로, 자영업, 예비창업

maritalStatus.description: Optional marital status. Do not infer if the user did not provide it.

householdType.description: Optional household type used for policy prioritization.

hasChildren.description: Optional explicit child-presence status. Do not infer if the user did not provide it.

childrenAges.description: Optional full ages of children. Example: [2, 6]. Use only when explicitly provided.

annualIncome.description: Optional annual income in 10,000 KRW units. Used only as a counseling clue, not an eligibility determination.

interest.description: Main interest area such as 취업·훈련, 주거, 금융, 생계, 의료, 심리·마음건강, 돌봄, 교육·문화, 청년정책

keyword.description: Optional additional search keyword extracted from the user's question
